root_cause.text: In `net/sched/act_mirred`’s `tcf_blockcast_redir()` loop, the code passed `dev_is_mac_header_xmit(dev)` for the packet being redirected to `dev_prev`, so mixed-device block redirection used the next device’s MAC-header mode instead of the actual target device’s, causing incorrect header push/pull handling and skb corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `tcf_mirred_to_dev(skb, m, dev_prev, dev_is_mac_header_xmit(dev), ...)` to `dev_is_mac_header_xmit(dev_prev)`, and the CVE description states the loop “sends to `dev_prev` but queries `dev_is_mac_header_xmit(dev)` — which is the NEXT device,” leading to wrong `mac_header_xmit` decisions and possible `skb_push_rcsum` headroom exhaustion.
